global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and menma bamboo shoots. Bright green scallions crown the noodles in a white bowl with red kanji, set against a warm orange surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Orange table surface, smooth and flat, with subtle wood grain texture visible beneath the bowl's shadow.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red characters and green floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, circular rim with decorative border.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu broth with noodles shows rich brown liquid, swirling noodles, and green scallions floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, light brown slices with visible fat marbling and green onion garnish on top.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, sliced into thick, slightly curved pieces with glossy, moist surfaces.
